text_block_list.text:
"Wanna go check out the sea?" —It happened 
when she invited me and we visited the 
beach.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If it isn't Cafe! You look down, is 
something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... I felt like I might encounter 
something wondrous... so I was just taking 
a walk...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? Do you guys wanna join the 'Megalodon 
Expedition Team' too~~?!
choice_data_list:
(So you got dragged into Golshi's 
antics...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The extinct species, Megalodon!!! Let's 
dry it into niboshi... and taste 23 
million years' worth of broth!
choice_data_list: W-Well, I wonder if we'll find it...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Searching for an extinct, 
legendary shark! Now THAT is what I call 
romance!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's ride it, Trainer! Who knows, we 
might just encounter some massive 
"romance"!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You think so too, don't you, Cafe? 
Memories of eternity sleeping beneath the 
dark ocean floor... It's so enticing, 
isn't it!"

Could an extinct species really be found? 
Thinking that, I accompanied her fishing 
anyway, and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Got a hit! I feel like this one's gonna be 
huge!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is... a sea bass... Seems it's quite 
familiar to anglers...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it'd taste great grilled! 
Though, it ain't our catch.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Order up! Freshly caught, lively 
swordfish! What should I roll next, Boss?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Nice one! With the two of us, I'm sure we 
could even catch a Megalodon!"

They are thoroughly earnest in everything 
they do. Seeing how hard they work... I 
simply can't just sit by and do nothing.
choice_data_list:
What do you say we try a different fishing 
spot?
How about we try a different fishing spot?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Good idea, Trainer! Maybe we'll catch a 
different kind of fish!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We're catching plenty of fish, 
but... our real target is a tough one!
choice_data_list: Even though I've been looking so hard...

text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I don't think it'll be found. 
Yet, when I think of their refusal to give 
up, a feeling of regret wells up inside 
me."

If nothing else, I just want to catch at 
least one rare fish... Just as I made that 
wish—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait... This is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, over here... To the point where 
the fluctuations are greatest...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I just gotta fish here? All right! I'll 
take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, this sensation...!? Hmph—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa whoa whoa...! What is this 
spiky fish?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Little sculpin... ...It is a fish... 
that lives in the deep sea...
choice_data_list: A deep-sea fish in shallows like these!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hyahaaa! Just dove in for a bit and caught 
a whole bunch of weird fish! This is 
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look at that pill-bug-looking guy over 
there! Talk about being way too pushy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A faintly glowing jellyfish... It's almost 
like an otherworldly being... ...I feel 
like I could watch it forever...

Fish that should be impossible to find on 
a sandy beach. Yet they are undeniably 
right before my eyes.

If something like this can happen, then 
maybe even the Megalodon is still out 
there alive—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...See? Exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Most of the ocean is unexplored territory 
that no one has ever reached.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the ocean is vastly larger than the 
land. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whatever happens in this sea, whatever's 
sleeping beneath it, nothing would 
surprise me. ...Right?

You might just stumble upon something 
truly grand and romantic. I felt like I 
finally understood why she said that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! This vast ocean—no, this whole 
world! It's overflowing with things we 
don't know about!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Extinct animals, once-thriving undersea 
cities, treasures grand enough to conquer 
the world—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Treasures like that might be sleeping 
there! Just thinking about it gets me 
hyped! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That racing pulse in your chest—that's 
what we call "romance"!
choice_data_list: The Earth is overflowing with romance!

The Earth is overflowing with romance, 
isn't it!
I wanna find a megalodon someday.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That racing pulse in your chest—that's 
what we call "romance"!
choice_data_list: The Earth is overflowing with romance!

The Earth is overflowing with romance, 
isn't it!
I wanna find a megalodon someday.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! You guys think so too, 
don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know if it's romantic, but... 
I... like the ocean floor too...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"A world devoid of light, like an eternal 
night... Surely any kind of mysterious 
thing could..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan knows the truth... Down on the 
ocean floor, there's a bunch of Object X's 
from outer space crawlin' around...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you get it! It wouldn't be half bad 
for all of us to just stay here and talk 
about "romance" like this!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I love that idea! Sailing the seven seas, 
on a grand adventure across the globe— 
just thinking about it gets my heart 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you guys want, how about it? Wanna 
climb aboard my ship?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...If I can peer into the deep sea... it 
might not be so bad...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan agrees too! But the vessel's 
gotta be the golden submarine, the 
'Gol-Gol Ship'!
